items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Snoozer and Lloyd Ellis played very, very much alike.

ctx.x: Snoozer and Lloyd Ellis played very, very much alike. And Snoozer and I were good friends and we only met. He said one, he came in there one night, he says, I sure like the way you play. He says, I play a little guitar. He said, would you mind if I played a little bit with you? I said, no, sir, I'd be tickled to death. Boy, when he took that guitar out of that case and started to, there was no amplification. Just the guitar by itself. But it had a tone out of this world. And how he played was nobody's business.…
Yeah, I think I've heard people talk about him at the firm.
